paragraphs.text: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?
paragraphs.original: Τί οὖν τὸ περισσὸν τοῦ Ἰουδαίου, ἢ τίς ἡ ὠφέλεια τῆς περιτομῆς;
paragraphs.translit: Ti oun to perisson tou Ioudaiou, ē tis hē ōpheleia tēs peritomēs;

paragraphs.text: Much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of God.
paragraphs.original: πολὺ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον. πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ ὅτι ἐπιστεύθησαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: poly kata panta tropon. prōton men gar hoti episteuthēsan ta logia tou theou.

paragraphs.text: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?
paragraphs.original: τί γάρ; εἰ ἠπίστησάν τινες, μὴ ἡ ἀπιστία αὐτῶν τὴν πίστιν τοῦ θεοῦ καταργήσει;
paragraphs.translit: ti gar; ei ēpistēsan tines, mē hē apistia autōn tēn pistin tou theou katargēsei;

paragraphs.text: God forbid: yea, let God be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy words, And mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.
paragraphs.original: μὴ γένοιτο· γινέσθω δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἀληθής, πᾶς δὲ ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης, καθὼς γέγραπται· Ὅπως ἂν δικαιωθῇς ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου καὶ νικήσεις ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαί σε.
paragraphs.translit: mē genoito· ginesthō de ho theos alēthēs, pas de anthrōpos pseustēs, kathōs gegraptai· Hopōs an dikaiōthēs en tois logois sou kai nikēseis en tō krinesthai se.

paragraphs.text: But if our righteousness commendeth the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? (I speak after the manner of men.)
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀδικία ἡμῶν θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην συνίστησιν, τί ἐροῦμεν; μὴ ἄδικος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐπιφέρων τὴν ὀργήν; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω.
paragraphs.translit: ei de hē adikia hēmōn theou dikaiosynēn synistēsin, ti eroumen; mē adikos ho theos ho epipherōn tēn orgēn; kata anthrōpon legō.

paragraphs.text: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
paragraphs.original: μὴ γένοιτο· ἐπεὶ πῶς κρινεῖ ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον;
paragraphs.translit: mē genoito· epei pōs krinei ho theos ton kosmon;

paragraphs.text: But if the truth of God through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ ψεύσματι ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, τί ἔτι κἀγὼ ὡς ἁμαρτωλὸς κρίνομαι,
paragraphs.translit: ei de hē alētheia tou theou en tō emō pseusmati eperisseusen eis tēn doxan autou, ti eti kagō hōs hamartōlos krinomai,

paragraphs.text: and why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μὴ καθὼς βλασφημούμεθα καὶ καθώς φασίν τινες ἡμᾶς λέγειν ὅτι Ποιήσωμεν τὰ κακὰ ἵνα ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀγαθά; ὧν τὸ κρίμα ἔνδικόν ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai mē kathōs blasphēmoumetha kai kathōs phasin tines hēmas legein hoti Poiēsōmen ta kaka hina elthē ta agatha; hōn to krima endikon estin.

paragraphs.text: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;
paragraphs.original: Τί οὖν; προεχόμεθα; οὐ πάντως, προῃτιασάμεθα γὰρ Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας πάντας ὑφʼ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι,
paragraphs.translit: Ti oun; proechometha; ou pantōs, proētiasametha gar Ioudaious te kai Hellēnas pantas hyphʼ hamartian einai,

paragraphs.text: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one;
paragraphs.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἔστιν δίκαιος οὐδὲ εἷς,
paragraphs.translit: kathōs gegraptai hoti Ouk estin dikaios oude heis,

paragraphs.text: There is none that understandeth, There is none that seeketh after God;
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ συνίων, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὸν θεόν·
paragraphs.translit: ouk estin ho syniōn, ouk estin ho ekzētōn ton theon·

paragraphs.text: They have all turned aside, they are together become       unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not, so much as one:
paragraphs.original: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν, ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν· οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν χρηστότητα, οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός.
paragraphs.translit: pantes exeklinan, hama ēchreōthēsan· ouk estin poiōn chrēstotēta, ouk estin heōs henos.

paragraphs.text: Their throat is an open sepulchre; With their tongues they have used deceit: The poison of asps is under their lips:
paragraphs.original: τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν, ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν, ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν,
paragraphs.translit: taphos aneōgmenos ho larynx autōn, tais glōssais autōn edoliousan, ios aspidōn hypo ta cheilē autōn,

paragraphs.text: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
paragraphs.original: ὧν τὸ στόμα ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας γέμει·
paragraphs.translit: hōn to stoma aras kai pikrias gemei·

paragraphs.text: Their feet are swift to shed blood;
paragraphs.original: ὀξεῖς οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐκχέαι αἷμα,
paragraphs.translit: oxeis hoi podes autōn ekcheai haima,

paragraphs.text: Destruction and misery are in their ways;
paragraphs.original: σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν,
paragraphs.translit: syntrimma kai talaipōria en tais hodois autōn,

paragraphs.text: And the way of peace have they not known:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hodon eirēnēs ouk egnōsan.

paragraphs.text: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ouk estin phobos theou apenanti tōn ophthalmōn autōn.

paragraphs.text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God:
paragraphs.original: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὅσα ὁ νόμος λέγει τοῖς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ λαλεῖ, ἵνα πᾶν στόμα φραγῇ καὶ ὑπόδικος γένηται πᾶς ὁ κόσμος τῷ θεῷ·
paragraphs.translit: Oidamen de hoti hosa ho nomos legei tois en tō nomō lalei, hina pan stoma phragē kai hypodikos genētai pas ho kosmos tō theō·

paragraphs.text: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law [cometh] the knowledge of sin.
paragraphs.original: διότι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ δικαιωθήσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, διὰ γὰρ νόμου ἐπίγνωσις ἁμαρτίας.
paragraphs.translit: dioti ex ergōn nomou ou dikaiōthēsetai pasa sarx enōpion autou, dia gar nomou epignōsis hamartias.

paragraphs.text: But now apart from the law a righteousness of God hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
paragraphs.original: Νυνὶ δὲ χωρὶς νόμου δικαιοσύνη θεοῦ πεφανέρωται, μαρτυρουμένη ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Nyni de chōris nomou dikaiosynē theou pephanerōtai, martyroumenē hypo tou nomou kai tōn prophētōn,

paragraphs.text: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;
paragraphs.original: δικαιοσύνη δὲ θεοῦ διὰ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, εἰς πάντας τοὺς πιστεύοντας, οὐ γάρ ἐστιν διαστολή.
paragraphs.translit: dikaiosynē de theou dia pisteōs Iēsou Christou, eis pantas tous pisteuontas, ou gar estin diastolē.

paragraphs.text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
paragraphs.original: πάντες γὰρ ἥμαρτον καὶ ὑστεροῦνται τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: pantes gar hēmarton kai hysterountai tēs doxēs tou theou,

paragraphs.text: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: δικαιούμενοι δωρεὰν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι διὰ τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: dikaioumenoi dōrean tē autou chariti dia tēs apolytrōseōs tēs en Christō Iēsou·

paragraphs.text: whom God set forth [to be] a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of God;
paragraphs.original: ὃν προέθετο ὁ θεὸς ἱλαστήριον διὰ πίστεως ἐν τῷ αὐτοῦ αἵματι εἰς ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ διὰ τὴν πάρεσιν τῶν προγεγονότων ἁμαρτημάτων
paragraphs.translit: hon proetheto ho theos hilastērion dia pisteōs en tō autou haimati eis endeixin tēs dikaiosynēs autou dia tēn paresin tōn progegonotōn hamartēmatōn

paragraphs.text: for the showing, [I say], of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in Jesus.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τῇ ἀνοχῇ τοῦ θεοῦ, πρὸς τὴν ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν δίκαιον καὶ δικαιοῦντα τὸν ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: en tē anochē tou theou, pros tēn endeixin tēs dikaiosynēs autou en tō nyn kairō, eis to einai auton dikaion kai dikaiounta ton ek pisteōs Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: Where then is the glorying? It is excluded. By what manner of law? of works? Nay: but by a law of faith.
paragraphs.original: Ποῦ οὖν ἡ καύχησις; ἐξεκλείσθη. διὰ ποίου νόμου; τῶν ἔργων; οὐχί, ἀλλὰ διὰ νόμου πίστεως.
paragraphs.translit: Pou oun hē kauchēsis; exekleisthē. dia poiou nomou; tōn ergōn; ouchi, alla dia nomou pisteōs.

paragraphs.text: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
paragraphs.original: λογιζόμεθα γὰρ δικαιοῦσθαι πίστει ἄνθρωπον χωρὶς ἔργων νόμου.
paragraphs.translit: logizometha gar dikaiousthai pistei anthrōpon chōris ergōn nomou.

paragraphs.text: Or is God [the God] of Jews only? is he not [the God] of Gentiles also? Yea, of Gentiles also:
paragraphs.original: ἢ Ἰουδαίων ὁ θεὸς μόνον; οὐχὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν; ναὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν,
paragraphs.translit: ē Ioudaiōn ho theos monon; ouchi kai ethnōn; nai kai ethnōn,

paragraphs.text: if so be that God is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.
paragraphs.original: εἴπερ εἷς ὁ θεός, ὃς δικαιώσει περιτομὴν ἐκ πίστεως καὶ ἀκροβυστίαν διὰ τῆς πίστεως.
paragraphs.translit: eiper heis ho theos, hos dikaiōsei peritomēn ek pisteōs kai akrobystian dia tēs pisteōs.

paragraphs.text: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.
paragraphs.original: νόμον οὖν καταργοῦμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως; μὴ γένοιτο, ἀλλὰ νόμον ἱστάνομεν.
paragraphs.translit: nomon oun katargoumen dia tēs pisteōs; mē genoito, alla nomon histanomen.
